title: On the Interplay between Human Label Variation and Model Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring group-level parity by taking the ratio of soft F1 performance scores between in-group and out-of-group subsets for racial groups (in the SBIC dataset) and Indigenous populations (in the TAG dataset).
Measuring group-level parity by taking the ratio of soft F1 performance scores between in-group and out-of-group subsets for gender identities in offensiveness classification using the SBIC dataset.
Measuring group-level parity by taking the ratio of soft F1 performance scores between in-group and out-of-group subsets for disabled individuals using the SBIC dataset.

Measuring group-level parity by taking the ratio of soft F1 performance scores between in-group and out-of-group subsets for low-income earners, public housing dwellers, and those experiencing homelessness in the TAG legal dataset.
Measuring group-level parity by taking the ratio of soft F1 performance scores between in-group and out-of-group subsets for LGBTQ+ cohorts using the TAG legal dataset.
Measuring group-level parity by taking the ratio of soft F1 performance scores between in-group and out-of-group subsets for senior cohorts using the TAG legal dataset.
Measuring group-level parity by taking the ratio of soft F1 performance scores between in-group and out-of-group subsets for cultural categories using the SBIC dataset.
